allOf.description: An `AccessURL` that can be used to fetch the actual object bytes. Note that at least one of `access_url` and `access_id` must be provided.

access_id.description: An arbitrary string to be passed to the `/access` method to get an `AccessURL`. This string must be unique within the scope of a single object.

cloud.description: Name of the cloud service provider that the object belongs to. If the cloud service is Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform or Azure, the values should be `aws`, `gcp`, or `azure` respectively.

region.description: Name of the region in the cloud service provider that the object belongs to.

available.description: Availability of the file in the cloud. False means the file is delayed, thawing, or otherwise not immediately accessible via DRS.

allOf.description: When `access_id` is provided, `authorizations` provides information about how to authorize the `/access` method.
